item.text:
The product title now lives in the [product layout](/workspace/app/product/layout.tsx), so it can appear as soon as navigation begins. The [loading state](/workspace/app/product/loading.tsx) appears beneath it while the [product page](/workspace/app/product/page.tsx) fetches live stock and price.

The production build passes. I also verified that the route’s prefetch response contains the title and loading message, with inventory loaded when the page opens. The build still reports a preexisting warning that this Next.js version does not recognize `cacheComponents`.
